name: framedock
description: FrameDock desktop creative workspace, based on Infinite Canvas

scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run pack:mac --
scripts.pack:mac: node script/prepare-desktop.mjs && npm --prefix desktop run pack:mac --
scripts.build: npm --prefix canvas-agent run build && sh script/build-plugins.sh && npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix desktop run build
